title: Where Are the Rates? Derivative-Implied Interest Rates in Cryptocurrency Markets
abstract: arXiv:2509.03964v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In traditional finance, liquid markets for bonds, interest rate swaps, and other interest rate derivatives provide a basis for constructing yield curves. In the cryptocurrency ecosystem, lending and staking yields are predominantly variable and adjust over short timescales, whereas fixed-rate instruments remain scarce and, as of early 2026, widely accepted benchmark yield curves were still lacking. We jointly infer USD and cryptocurrency discount factors from inverse options and futures by combining put-call parity with the futures basis in a closed-form estimator. We introduce a novel RANSAC-based quote filter tailored to cryptocurrency market microstructure. We apply the method to hourly BTC and ETH derivatives data from Deribit between February~2023 and February~2026. The two underlying assets imply broadly similar USD term structures, with rates averaging approximately 8\% per year and rising during the 2024 cryptocurrency rallie

translated_title: 利率在哪里？加密货币市场中由衍生品隐含的利率
translated_abstract: 在传统金融中，债券、利率互换及其他利率衍生品的流动市场为构建收益率曲线提供了基础。而在加密货币生态系统中，借贷和质押收益率大多为浮动性质并在短时间内调整，固定利率工具仍然稀缺，且截至2026年初，广受认可的基准收益率曲线依然缺失。我们通过将看跌-看涨平价与期货基差结合于一个闭式估计器中，从反向期权和期货中联合推断美元及加密货币的贴现因子。我们提出了一种新颖的基于RANSAC的报价过滤器，专门针对加密货币市场微观结构量身定制。我们将该方法应用于Deribit交易所2023年2月至2026年2月期间BTC和ETH的小时级衍生品数据。两种标的资产所隐含的美元期限结构大体相似，利率平均约为每年8%，并在2024年加密货币牛市期间有所上升。
tldr: 该论文提出一种结合看跌-看涨平价与期货基差的闭式估计器，从加密货币衍生品中联合推断美元和加密货币的隐含贴现因子，为长期缺失基准收益率曲线的加密货币市场构建了利率期限结构。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a closed-form estimator combining put-call parity with the futures basis to jointly infer USD and cryptocurrency implied discount factors from derivatives, constructing benchmark yield curves that were previously lacking in cryptocurrency markets.
